note: Rasgos narrativos. kw: expresiones (sin distinguir mayúsculas) sobre los nombres en inglés de las palabras clave de TMDB; evidencia documentada por la comunidad de TMDB. proto: descripciones en inglés para la detección semántica sobre sinopsis y argumento (inferencia, confianza limitada). strength: cuánto aporta a la similitud (strong > medium > weak).

facets.label: conflicto de clases: ricos frente a quienes los sirven
proto: Wealthy, privileged people clash with the staff who serve them, exposing class tensions and inequality.
The story contrasts the lives of the rich elite with the workers around them.

facets.label: sátira de los ricos y su hipocresía
proto: A sharp satire that mocks rich people and exposes their hypocrisy and entitlement.

facets.label: familia disfuncional y viejos rencores
proto: A dysfunctional family is torn apart by resentment, inheritance disputes and old grievances.

facets.label: parejas en crisis: infidelidad, celos y mentiras
proto: Couples whose relationships are strained by infidelity, jealousy, temptation and lies.
A marriage in crisis where attraction to another person threatens everything.

facets.label: grupo de amigos cuyas relaciones se resquebrajan
proto: A close group of friends whose relationships unravel as resentments, rivalries and secrets surface.
Old friends gather regularly and their friendship slowly turns toxic.

facets.label: manipulación y engaño entre personajes
proto: A manipulative person deceives and controls others through lies and psychological games.
Characters manipulate one another, and no one can tell who is lying.

facets.label: lucha por el poder y el estatus
proto: Rivals scheme against each other in a ruthless struggle for power, money and status.
Characters compete for social status and dominance over the group.

facets.label: relación abusiva o tóxica
proto: A toxic, controlling relationship in which one partner abuses and dominates the other.

facets.label: secretos y mentiras que salen a la luz
proto: Long-buried secrets and lies gradually come to light and change how everyone sees each other.
Behind a polished facade, each character hides a dark secret.

facets.label: doble vida o identidad falsa
proto: A person lives a double life under a false identity, deceiving those closest to them.

facets.label: chantaje
proto: Someone is blackmailed with a compromising secret.

facets.label: misterio de «quién lo hizo» con varios sospechosos
proto: A death occurs and the story keeps the audience guessing which of the suspects is responsible.

facets.label: grupo cerrado en un lugar aislado donde crece la sospecha
proto: A small group of people confined to one isolated place, where tension and suspicion steadily grow.

facets.label: suspenso psicológico y paranoia
proto: A psychological thriller full of paranoia and obsession in which nobody can be trusted.

facets.label: conspiración
proto: Characters uncover a conspiracy and a powerful cover-up.

facets.label: desaparición
proto: Someone disappears and those left behind search for the truth.

facets.label: investigación policial o de detective
proto: A detective investigates a crime and follows clues to find the culprit.

facets.label: vacaciones o escapada de lujo que se tuerce
proto: Guests on a luxury vacation or retreat reveal their darker sides as the days pass.

facets.label: reuniones sociales (cenas, fiestas, bodas) que terminan en conflicto
proto: A social gathering such as a dinner party where polite conversation turns into confrontations and revelations.

facets.label: fachada perfecta (barrio, comunidad) que oculta tensiones
proto: Behind the perfect facade of an affluent neighborhood, neighbors hide resentments, affairs and secrets.

facets.label: tentación y límites morales de la pareja
proto: A couple's boundaries are tested by temptation and desire for someone else.
An exchange between two couples or families unleashes desire, envy and hidden tensions.

facets.label: envidia y comparación con los demás
proto: Characters envy each other's lives and compare themselves constantly, breeding resentment.

facets.label: codicia, dinero y fraude
proto: Greed and money problems push characters toward fraud and betrayal.

facets.label: venganza
proto: A character seeks revenge for a past wrong.

facets.label: supervivencia
proto: People struggle to survive in a hostile situation.

facets.label: crisis personal y búsqueda de uno mismo
proto: Characters in a personal crisis question who they are and what they want from life.

facets.label: duelo y pérdida
proto: Characters cope with grief after the death of someone they loved.

facets.label: culpa y dilemas morales
proto: Characters face a moral dilemma and must live with guilt over their choices.

facets.label: paso a la adultez
proto: A teenager comes of age while facing first love, school and family.

facets.label: obsesión
proto: A character becomes dangerously obsessed with another person.

facets.label: historia de amor central
proto: A love story between two people is at the center of the plot.

facets.label: humor negro y mordaz
proto: A darkly comic, sardonic story that mixes biting humor with discomfort.

facets.label: tono provocador e incómodo
proto: A provocative, uncomfortable story that pushes taboo subjects.

facets.label: tono amable y reconfortante
proto: A heartwarming, lighthearted and uplifting story.

facets.label: tono sombrío y desolador
proto: A bleak, grim and despairing story with little hope.

facets.label: tensión sostenida
proto: A tense, suspenseful story that keeps building pressure.

facets.label: melodrama
proto: A melodrama full of passionate emotions and dramatic twists.

facets.label: horror explícito o sobrenatural
proto: Supernatural or graphic horror with ghosts, demons or monsters.

facets.label: ritmo pausado que construye tensión
proto: A slow-burn story that patiently builds atmosphere and tension.

facets.label: ritmo vertiginoso
proto: A fast-paced, frenetic story racing against time.

facets.label: trama compleja tipo rompecabezas
proto: An intricate, puzzle-like plot that the viewer must piece together.

facets.label: empieza por el final (un hecho grave) y retrocede para explicar cómo se llegó
proto: The story opens with a death or a crime and then flashes back to show how events led there.
We know from the first scene that something terrible happened; the story rewinds to reveal how.

facets.label: estructura no lineal o con flashbacks
proto: The story jumps between past and present timelines.

facets.label: reparto coral con varias historias cruzadas
proto: An ensemble story that follows several characters' intertwined storylines from multiple points of view.

facets.label: alta intensidad emocional
proto: An emotionally devastating, harrowing story.

facets.label: humor incómodo
proto: Comedy built on awkward, embarrassing situations.

facets.label: humor absurdo
proto: An absurd, surreal comedy.
